Agent was created before the introduction of this field. The mode is either 'None' if no authentication was configured, or 'Generic OAuth2' if the agent had an authentication node.
The agent does not require authentication.

Authentication uses integrated Entra ID configuration. Supports security group access control. The agent has access to the UserId and UserDisplayName variables and will be able to invoke Flows on behalf of the end user. No additional configuration required.

Provide a custom Entra ID application. Supports security group access control. The agent has access to the IsLoggedIn, AuthToken, UserId and UserDisplayName variables and will be able to invoke Flows on behalf of the user. Skills can leverage the auth token
A custom OAuth provider is configured. The agent will have access to the IsLoggedIn and AuthToken variables.
Defines at which point authentication for the agent should be triggered. Security can be enforced at the agent entry point, removing the need for explicit authentication nodes in the dialog flow.
Defines at which point authentication for the agent should be triggered. Security can be enforced at the agent entry point, removing the need for explicit authentication nodes in the dialog flow.
Sign in happens when the agent reaches an authentication node or when an action requires user authentication.
Sign-in happens when the conversation starts and any time a token expires.
